title: Man charged in deadly Framingham hit-and-run
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime A pedestrian was struck and killed Monday night.
A man was charged in a hit-and-run crash that killed a 62-year-old pedestrian on Monday night.

Ronei DeOliveira, 44, of Framingham, was arraigned Tuesday in Framingham District Court in connection with allegations that he struck and killed the pedestrian, identified as Philip Bligh, of Framingham, the previous night, the Middlesex County District Attorney’s Office said in a release.

title: Mass. teacher arrested on child pornography charges
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime “The safety and well-being of our students and staff remain our highest priority.
” A Chicopee Public Schools teacher was placed on leave after being arrested Tuesday on child pornography charges.

Keith Harrison, 46, of Lenox, was charged with two counts of possession of child pornography, one count of attempting to commit a crime of indecent assault and battery on a child under 14, and one count of dissemination of child pornography, according to the Berkshire District Attorney’s Office.
